The name Faaizah is derived from the Arabic word faaiz, which means one who wins or achieves victory. In Islamic tradition, the name Faaizah is associated with spiritual excellence and is considered a blessing from Allah. The name Faaizah is also associated with the qualities of courage, strength, and determination. In modern times, the name Faaizah has become popular in many Muslim cultures, including Arabic, Urdu, and Turkish-speaking communities.
